title: Reporting Dimension Systems
description: Experimental (media_buy.reporting_subscriptions). The classification system behind each geography breakdown that has more than one, so a metro or postal breakdown names which codes its rows carry. On an offering it states the systems the offering reports in; on a subscription selector it narrows which offerings match. Rows for these dimensions carry codes in exactly these systems, the same values geo-delivery-metrics.json uses for geo_code.

metro.description: Metro system of the metro breakdown, such as nielsen_dma. Required on an offering whose standard_dimensions include metro.

postal_area.description: Countries and their postal systems in the postal_area breakdown, each a native country-local postal system. Required on an offering whose standard_dimensions include postal_area.

system.description: Country-local postal system, such as zip for US or outward for GB.
